sources.title: AgriSense
sources.snippet: AgriSense develops ultra-precise, AI-powered soil sensors that provide real-time data on soil health, moisture, and nutrient levels. These sensors use machine learning to predict and optimize soil conditions for each crop type, ensuring both enhanced productivity and soil preservation.
